prompt: New alert: the assigned driver reports they cannot reach the selected pickup after their current duty. Work the case.

alerts.summary: Assigned driver reports they cannot reach the selected Leipzig pickup after their current duty. Human review needed.
alerts.next_action: Check replacement drivers, then seek buyer approval before changing the slot or assignment.

messages.text: I am still on CD-420326, heading toward Hamburg. After that handover I need my rest. My first time to travel is after 12:00 tomorrow local time, so I cannot reach the selected Leipzig collection slot. I have no travel booking. Please check a replacement or ask the customer about another slot.

Driver reported no workable positioning to the selected Leipzig pickup after their active Hamburg duty. Previous-duty tracking is only an ETA. Confirm the driver constraint, then review replacement capacity or a customer-approved change. The assignment remains accepted.
Driver called from CD-420326 and says they need rest before another pickup. They won't reach the Leipzig slot on CD-420399. I don't see any positioning ticket booked. Who can cover that slot?

Keep the accepted assignment on CD-420399 while we check replacement capacity. Please prepare a buyer update that says collection timing is under review, without naming the driver's earlier customer's trip. No changed slot has been agreed.

open_work.next_action: Check replacement drivers for the existing Leipzig slot. If none can take it, obtain buyer approval before changing the slot and only then adjust the assignment.

input.question: Driver cannot reach the pickup slot after current duty because they need rest; can the slot or assignment be changed, and who decides?

entries.answer: Confirm the constraint in the driver's own words — where they finish and the earliest they can start — and record it. The assignment remains accepted until they withdraw.
cautions: A previous duty's ETA and a home city are not a current location.
A travel quote is not a booked ticket.
A changed slot needs the customer to agree, and the agent may not contact a customer.

entries.answer: Apparent damage has to be noted at delivery. Hidden damage must be reported within 7 days, excluding Sundays and public holidays. A CMR delay claim needs a written reservation within 21 days.
cautions: A late claim is not automatically void: the deadline does not apply where the damage could not reasonably have been discovered.
Never tell a driver a claim is time-barred. That is a commercial decision.

entries.answer: There is 45 minutes of free waiting time at pickup or delivery. Beyond that a waiting fee runs at €25 per vehicle per additional half hour on a driven transfer, capped at the empty pickup fee. Tell the driver to log when they arrived.
cautions: The waiting fee is charged to the customer, not paid to the driver. Never present it as the driver’s compensation.

corners.when: The free 45 minutes is nearly up and nothing is happening
corners.then: Record the arrival time and escalate before the driver leaves. A failed pickup the customer caused — car unavailable, not roadworthy, nobody authorised, missing documents or keys — is an empty pickup, and that is a commercial decision, not the driver’s.

output.note: Follow each entry's routing. Never assert anything listed under cautions.

output.error: No planning estimate from Hamburg to Leipzig.

Your delivery promise of 23 October, 13:00–15:00 local time, is not yet confirmed as affected. We will update you as soon as we know more.
